rows.obligation: Define the actual backend/platform/version/rounding/resource domain and establish termination without numerical or resource exceptions for every admitted raw history.

Prove an ordered singular-value error bound sufficient for both strict cutoff and source-scale floor, for example epsilon<=2^-41; complete-factor residual/Gram bounds are one sufficient route, not the only possible route.
Prove retained Gram and equation residual bounds at original caps, for actual returned vectors on every input; singular-value accuracy alone does not establish them.
Prove actual saved shift/LS output meets the original lag-operator bound; source LS and finite actual floating LS must remain distinct.
Prove actual complex eigenpairs, inverse residual and inverse norm meet original caps, including conditioning and matching branch behavior.
Prove actual argument and nearest-even emission bounds and bijection conditions; rank or eigenvalue errors alone do not supply codec correctness.
Prove the actual finite LS certificate obtains a positive validated Gram floor, and every verifier/custody/source identity premise is met; metadata PASS or hash identity alone is insufficient.
Independently support any acquisition/model/calibration/unit/clock/fresh-lineage premises before physical use. Computational completeness would still not supply these physical premises.
